fact: Congo's Agence de développement de l'économie numérique (Aden) is stated to ensure the technical management of the government's official web portal gouvernement.cg, per Les Dépêches de Brazzaville.
The Treasury sheet says the tax system E-TAX was built in-house by the ministry's information systems directorate.

The finance ministry reports that on 22 July 2025 it installed 5 service heads, 7 project heads and 6 assistants in its information systems directorate, several seconded from ACSI, to lead systems including SIGFIP, SIPAE, SYSPACE and SFEC.
